about_the_game: Designed for split-screen, local couch co-op, the game immerses gamers and non-gamers alike in a serene, wholesome, embroidered world free of combat. With its hand-”stitched” art style and emphasis on exploration, Embroideryvania redefines both co-op and metroidvania gameplay.
